4 اناخ (S, L, Msb) and ↓ نوّخ (L, Msb) He (a man) made a camel to lie down upon his breast [with his legs folded, as is done on the occasions of mounting and dismounting, &c.] (S, L, Msb.) Also, ↓ تنوّخ (S, L, K) and اناخ (K) and ↓ استناخ (L) He (a stallion-camel) made a she-camel to do so in order that he might (??) (S, K.) or made her do so and then covered her. (L.) ―
-b2- اناخ بِهِ البَلَآءُ وَالذُّلُّ (tropical:) [Trial, or affliction, and abasement, befell him]. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
